text:
People Ops: Pilot announcement — Emergency Travel Rebooking + PTO advance now live for qualifying immediate family emergencies. Policy, manager one-pager, and the quick claim form here: https://redwood.internal/policies/emergency-travel-pilot. Quick thread with FAQs below.

danielle_hr: TL;DR please?

People Ops: TL;DR — Redwood will reimburse reasonable rebooking/change fees up to $750 per incident and will auto-approve up to 3 days of PTO advance for same-day emergency travel changes. Submit the claim within 10 days of the rebooking. Manager notification requested ASAP but not required for approval.

pk_infra: $750 per person or per incident (e.g., family of 3)?

People Ops: Per incident. If you buy multiple tickets for the same emergency (child + partner), include separate receipts in the same claim and note passenger names.

emma_manager: Any retroactive coverage for folks who already rebooked last month?

People Ops: Yes — retroactive claims accepted for rebookings back to 2025-11-15. Attach original receipts and a short reason in the form; we may follow up for clarification.

finance_bot: Filing tip: use GL code EMG-TRV and tag claims with "emergency-rebook". Upload both the itinerary change confirmation and the payment receipt to speed processing.

danielle_hr: How does the PTO advance work with balances? Will it show as a loan?

People Ops: The advance is treated like a short-term loan against future accruals. It will be reconciled across the next 12 pay periods. If you leave Redwood before reconciliation completes, payroll will handle the remaining adjustment.

pk_infra: Does this apply to international employees and contractors?

People Ops: Applies to all Redwood employees globally, subject to local law and tax treatment. Contractors are not covered under this pilot. For cross-border tax questions, file the claim and we'll route to People Ops + Finance for region-specific guidance.

emma_manager: Can managers approve extra days if needed?

People Ops: Managers can request an exception via the form(if a teammate needs more than 3 advance days). Exceptions will be reviewed by People Ops and may require additional documentation.

travel_bot: Published: https://redwood.internal/policies/emergency-travel-pilot Form: https://redwood.internal/forms/emergency-travel-claim. Manager one-pager attached on the policy page.

finance_bot: Note on taxes: reimbursement may be taxable in some jurisdictions. We'll include a tax summary in the claim confirmation email.

danielle_hr: Any recommended evidence besides receipts?

People Ops: Good to include airline/rail change confirmation screenshot, the payment receipt, and a brief note describing the emergency (one sentence). No medical records required for initial claim; People Ops may request follow-up docs in rare cases.

emma_manager: Can we get a 15-min manager drop-in to run through examples?

People Ops: Yeswe're hosting a 20-min Q&A next Wednesday at 9am PT. Calendar invite posted to #people-ops-calendar. We'll update the FAQ after the session.

People Ops: Thanks everyone. If you have an urgent case now, DM People Ops and fill the form. Well prioritize true emergencies. :white_check_mark: :sparkles:
